subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the text evidence that supports the idea.

items.prompt:
Idea: 'Dara is kind.'
Text: 'She shared her lunch and helped a lost child.'
The evidence is:
A) She shared her lunch and helped a lost child
B) Dara is a name
C) I like Dara
items.answer: A) She shared her lunch and helped a lost child

steps: Actions prove kindness. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) She shared her lunch and helped a lost child

items.prompt:
A detail from a text that proves your point is called:
A) evidence
B) a title
C) a guess

steps: Supports the idea. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To write about a story, your ideas should be supported by:
A) evidence from the text
B) your lunch
C) the weather

steps: Use text evidence. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Idea: 'Polar bears are built for cold.'
Text: 'They have thick fur and a layer of fat.'
The BEST evidence is:
A) They have thick fur and a layer of fat
B) Polar bears are white
C) The Arctic is far
items.answer: A) They have thick fur and a layer of fat

steps: Fact supports the point. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) They have thick fur and a layer of fat

items.prompt:
Idea: 'Maya is brave.'
Which text detail is the BEST evidence?
A) She ran into the smoke to save the cat.
B) Maya has brown hair.
C) It was Tuesday.
items.answer: A) She ran into the smoke to save the cat.

solution.answer: A) She ran into the smoke to save the cat.

items.prompt:
Evidence from an INFORMATIONAL text is usually a:
A) fact or detail from the text
B) made-up story
C) personal wish
items.answer: A) fact or detail from the text

steps: Facts are evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) fact or detail from the text

items.prompt:
Idea: 'The king was greedy.'
Which detail BEST proves it?
A) He hoarded gold and refused to share any of it.
B) He wore a crown.
C) He lived in a castle.
items.answer: A) He hoarded gold and refused to share any of it.

steps: Hoarding shows greed. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) He hoarded gold and refused to share any of it.

items.prompt:
Why should you include EVIDENCE when writing about a text?
A) It proves your idea and makes your writing convincing
B) It makes the paper longer only
C) It hides your opinion
items.answer: A) It proves your idea and makes your writing convincing

steps: Evidence supports analysis. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) It proves your idea and makes your writing convincing
